source_reasoning: ODT comment export places office:annotation after a run; the old host inline default recursively included annotation author, date and body in document text.
The old host table reader selected nested annotation paragraphs and also used outer paragraph innerText, so generated cell comments could be counted twice.

The canonical paragraph reader already excluded inline office:annotation, but container enumeration, streaming extraction and namespace-less fallback did not exclude independent annotation stories, including generated ODS comments.
Namespace URI plus local name identifies annotations; alias prefixes are excluded and foreign/shadowed namespaces retain their existing visible content.
XmlPullReader.next emits a synthetic reduced-depth endElement for a self-closing tag, so the retained subtree-skip loop does not consume following siblings.
limitation: CrispCloud's dedicated host checkpoint does not update managed Quds sources or their manifest. The parent integration must vendor the reconciled canonical source before final qualification.
